notes: Frame: model metres, +X east, +Y grid north. Fixtures of the Village area added by hand in the fix-up pass. Pool fence: the 2017 LiDAR has a line of non-ground returns 1.0 to 1.4 m above the ground (median 1.27 m) along the north-west side of the pool deck (32 returns, rms 0.44 m about a straight fit) and along the south-west side (13 returns); the two fits meet at a right angle (89.5 deg) at the west corner. The south-west run lies 4.6 m outside the deck outline of v_water: that side of the deck is in a building's shadow in the ortho. No returns line up on the north-east and south-east sides (benches, railings and the Abbott and Costello Center's walls are there), so those sides are not drawn. Lamps: the 2017 LiDAR has almost no pole returns here (a search for isolated returns 2.5 to 14 m above the ground with nothing else within 3 m found two, one an umbrella); lamps are placed only where the 2020 ortho shows a pole's shadow or a lamp globe and, for one, a LiDAR return confirms it. Many more lamps stand in the Village (heads and shadows too faint or ambiguous at 0.15 m/px to place); they are not drawn.
